_about: English labels for the codes in CRA ident.csv, from the List of Charities 'Codes Lists' PDF (codes_en.pdf, version 1.0, 2021-05-26), dataset 80c00cdb-1358-415c-bb8b-0de7f12675b8, retrieved 2026-11-19. Sections 2.1 (categories), 2.2 (sub-categories, keyed '<category>-<sub-category>', since sub-category codes repeat across categories) and 2.4 (designations). Extracted with pypdf and checked against a second, layout-based extraction; one label (0150-0005) was completed by hand. The PDF lists no sub-categories for category 0155; ident.csv uses three, which src/build_orgs.py flags (docs/DATA_ISSUES.md).
